mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (proxied by INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market with wage pressures, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressures that the Fed is likely to address with further rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening supply side, leading to reduced economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% in a month.
